b.lede: Hackers are using fake OpenAI, SpaceX, and Anthropic event invitations to lure employees into phishing attacks, using two different phishing-as-a-service platforms to steal Microsoft and Google account credentials and authentication sessions. [...]
b.title: Fake OpenAI, SpaceX events used to steal Microsoft, Google accounts
